units.source_text: [\[25\]](#part1330.html#w25) 当时男童十一岁至十六岁时，为表示转变为成年人，举行改装、结发、加冠的仪式。

en.t: At that time, when boys were between eleven and sixteen years old, a ceremony was held to mark their transition into adulthood, in which they changed their attire, arranged their hair, and received a cap.
This was called the coming-of-age cap ceremony.
